items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I heard of him mostly with guys like Buddy Petit... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, not enough, I can't recall.

ctx.x: A bass player. I didn't even tell you about George playing bass. But he could play tramo too.

Well I heard of him mostly with guys like Buddy Petit, you know, on tramo. But he played bass in the brass band and stuff? Yeah, he played bass in the brass band. Did he play steady with any brass band?

Well, not enough, I can't recall. But I know he played some jobs. You know what? Sometimes he could sit in. You see, in those days, them boys, young, after he could play, those old guys would leave him and come up in the band. The band would play. And after he could play good enough to keep up, they would take him in that band if he wanted to come. They'd make it by my way to put on the pedal on. Yeah. That's the play with the band.
